and Renovation in DeSoto, TX Exterior Home Remodeling and Renovation in Flower Mound, TX FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS What is HomeStop, and what do you do? Think of us as your one-stop shop for all things home improvement! At HomeStop, we specialize in patios, pergolas, concrete coatings, pools & spas, window replacement, and more. Whether you’re upgrading your backyard or giving your home a fresh new look, we’re here to make it happen - stress-free and professionally done! Why should I choose HomeStop over other home improvement companies? Great question! With years of experience, top-notch materials, and a team that truly cares about your vision, we make home transformations easy and exciting. Plus, we keep things transparent, no hidden fees, no shortcuts, just great work at fair prices. Do you offer free consultations? Absolutely! We’d love to chat about your project and explore the best options for you. Just give us a call or fill out our online form, and we’ll schedule a time that works for you. Where do you provide services? We proudly serve Frisco, Texas, and surrounding areas. If you’re nearby and need a home upgrade, there’s a good chance we’ve got you covered! Just reach out, and we’ll confirm. What’s the difference between a patio and a pergola? Great question! A patio is a paved outdoor space - think of it as your personal backyard retreat. A pergola, on the other hand, is a stylish open-roof structure that provides shade and adds a decorative touch. Can you customize my patio or pergola? Of course! Whether you want a modern, minimalist patio or a classic wooden pergola, we tailor everything to fit your style and space. Your backyard should feel like you! How long does it take to install a patio or pergola? Timelines depend on the size and design, but most projects take a few days to a couple of weeks. We’ll keep you updated every step of the way! What’s the benefit of getting a concrete coating? Aside from looking sleek and modern, concrete coatings make your surfaces durable, weather-resistant, and easy to maintain. Where can I get concrete coatings applied? We do garages, driveways, patios, pool decks, and commercial spaces. Basically, if it’s concrete, we can coat it! How long does a concrete coating last? With proper care, a high-quality coating can last 10-20 years. That’s a solid investment for long-term durability! What kind of windows do you install? We offer energy-efficient, stylish, and durable windows, including double-hung, casement, picture, and sliding windows. How do I know if I need to replace my windows? If your windows are drafty, hard to open, foggy, or just outdated, it might be time for an upgrade. New windows can boost your home’s value and save you money on energy bills. Do you offer financing? Yes! We know home improvements can be a big investment, so we offer flexible financing options to fit your budget. Just ask, and we’ll walk you through it. Is there a warranty on your work? You bet! We stand by our craftsmanship and offer warranties on materials and labor. Your satisfaction isn’t just a goal - it’s a guarantee. reviews.text:
Highly recommend! We had a great experience getting our new patio done in Frisco. From day one, Homestop made the whole process feel easy — super responsive, patient with our design changes, and full of helpful suggestions. We looked at everything from wood to composite materials, and they had a ton of styles and finishes to explore.

You can tell they’ve been doing this a long time — the project was well-managed, stayed on schedule, and the final result was exactly what we’d hoped for. No upsells, no surprises — just solid, honest work at a reasonable price. Friendly team, smooth process, and a beautiful finished product. Would definitely recommend them to anyone in the DFW area.
reviews.author: Amod Dandge

reviews.text: Home Stop coated my 2-car and 3-car garage floors 7-years ago and they still look great.  So I just hired them to coat my three daughters 2-car garages (2 in Dallas and 1 in Fort Worth). They delivered in spades!  Two of the slabs had significant cracks and an old coating that was flaking up in chunks.  Home Stop grinded the slabs and filled the cracks with a poly material that’s flexible and will move with the slab to protect against future cracking.  Then applied the base coat, custom colored flakes and a clear top coat.  All three garages turned out beautifully!  Home Stop’s attention to detail was outstanding, and all done at a fair and competitive price.  I would highly recommend Home Stop for your garage floor coating project.
reviews.author: John Bick

reviews.text: I give 5 stars to Jay, Erick and Danielo who worked directly on my project. There was a small issue that needed fixed and these guys were professional, friendly and hardworking. They fixed it without question and went above and beyond. Workers like this are very hard to find these days and they are why this company is getting a 5 star review and any business owner should be proud to have hard working individuals like this on their team. Thanks again guys, you rock!
reviews.author: Cassandra Wood

reviews.text:
Quality of work was a 5 Star!
Lack of communication was a major issue.  Project that should have been started within 30 days of signing, June of 2025.  Finally finished the week of November 10, 2025.  Communication and Customer Service are key to me, we got none of that.  I wished I had read more reviews, as I would not have gone with this company.
reviews.author: Babs Jacobs

reviews.text: HomeStop Inc. did a fantastic job on our new patio cover! From start to finish, the experience was smooth and professional. Greg helped us design exactly what we wanted and made the process easy, and Luis did an excellent job with the installation — precise, clean, and efficient. The patio looks amazing and really upgraded our outdoor space. Highly recommend HomeStop for quality work and great service!
reviews.author: Susan Mendoz

reviews.text: Subcontractors beware. We were hired by this company/homestop to do several projects. I raised concerns on various of the projects due to lack of details and communication. Funny how clients didn't know we were going to show up or hadn't even seen drawings and we were already showing up to start work. A lot of the frustrations were from improper practices from pouring concrete on top of irrigation lines with less than a minimum coverage resulting in early cracking sped up by the heat and us being blamed and asked to do something about it. We attempted to overlay but seems like the slab shifted by then and we used a curing product which lasts up to a month before it starts falling off so the color was off. Footers we were asked for weren't marked even after I asked about this to make sure they were installed in the correct spot or at what elevation to pour. We were told none of the footers worked and that they weren't level. I offered at a meeting we had to repair anything that was incorrect even though it wasn't our fault as far as placement and we were never asked to do repairs after. Rather they did a backcharge for over $7,000 on their credit card payment which included projects that had no problems. Funny thing is their bank decided not to charge us the $15 dispute fee once we presented all the evidence. (For those that know the process or loophole if you will. Your bank will protect you even in the wrong and either tell the merchant to go to court or not charge any fees to the merchant.) Although we could sue or go the lien route we have never felt it is fair to the customer or the employees for the action taken by those in charge. In this case Amit who lives in India who has not replied as well to any of our inquiries.
reviews.author: Anthony Beltran

reviews.text: Absolutely love our new patio cover! It transformed our backyard into a cool, shaded retreat — perfect for Texas summers. The team was professional, on time, and paid great attention to detail. Worth every penny!”
reviews.author: Brazil C.

reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic company to work with. The quality of the work i can not be anymore impressed with. The guys really listened to what I wanted and delivered. Thank all very much. I would totally recommend to everyone and have.
reviews.author: jordan coe
